assessment: bounded prescan, not a comprehensive privacy guarantee; external final receipt binds complete sealed set
prescan_scope: 310 scratch files before privacy documentation and manifest
digest_scan: 40 digests from restricted evidence; bounded 128 MiB per view, recursion depth 18; no forbidden digests, candidates or exceptions in prescan
pattern_scan: flat regular bytes, escaped slashes normalized, local home/temporary/Windows user/email/credential patterns; no matches in prescan
exclusions: unknown sensitive values or encodings, unsupported formats, omitted symlinks, Git administrative metadata and history; raw commit metadata and whole private queues remain external
rerun: final complete packet scan including manifest separately receipted to avoid self-referential digest; private corpus needed to reproduce digest scan
